assets.name: quiet-corner-light.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: subtle 16:9 presentation background, light register, opaque, 1672x941 target
Primary request: Create a quiet Universal Profiles ambient slide background, emphatically not hero art. Use Image 1 only as reference for the solid closed UP! cube material and Image 2 only as reference for quiet background restraint.
Subject: One small solid sealed glossy periwinkle UP! cube resting near the lower-right edge, occupying about 8% of the frame. It is a monolithic rounded die with a smooth continuous closed top and side planes and exact white "UP!" once on the front face.
Scene/backdrop: near-white cool mist canvas with one faint frosted profile-card plane behind the cube, two very soft pearlescent spheres, and a thin translucent ribbon fading into atmospheric haze. Supporting objects are low contrast, partially obscured by diffusion, and visually recede behind slide content.
Composition/framing: keep the left 68% completely calm and evenly luminous for headings, body copy, charts, and transparent app screenshots; all objects remain in the outer lower-right 28%; generous negative space; no object crosses the copy zone.
Lighting/mood: high-key diffused light, restrained periwinkle/blush/cyan reflections, no hard highlights.
Constraints: one opaque UP! cube only; no other readable text; fully opaque edge-to-edge canvas; brand object is subordinate, not focal.
Avoid: dense collage, central subject, high contrast, sharp clutter, people, faces, footwear, logos, hole, opening, slot, lid, rim, cavity, recess, insert, handle, tab, protrusion, object entering or emerging from a cube, watermark, transparent canvas.
